parameters.query:
select $1::jsonb as s, fatos_sessao($1::jsonb->>'sessao') as fatos,
       (select string_agg('- ' || tema || ': ' || texto, E'\n' order by ordem) from politicas_loja) as politicas

insert into sim_conversas (rodada, persona_id, sessao, canal, transcricao, turnos, desfecho, fatos, notas, nota_geral, aprovado, problemas, sugestao, duracao_ms)
select j->>'rodada', (j->>'persona_id')::bigint, j->>'sessao', j->>'canal', j->'transcricao', (j->>'turnos')::int, j->>'desfecho',
       j->'fatos', j->'notas', (j->>'nota_geral')::numeric, (j->>'aprovado')::boolean, j->'problemas', j->>'sugestao', (j->>'duracao_ms')::int
from (select $1::jsonb as j) p
returning id, rodada, sessao
